content: TypeScript 7.0.2 (GA 2026-07-08) ships no stable programmatic API; typescript-eslint 8.71.1 peer is typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. Microsoft recommends aliasing: typescript -> npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2 (JS API for tools) and @typescript/native -> npm:typescript@^7.0.2 for the fast tsc CLI. Stable 7.x API expected in 7.1. TS7 removes baseUrl, target es5, moduleResolution node10; defaults strict:true, module esnext, types:[].
